preconditions.description: Attacker must be the current owner of the contract

exploit_hint: As the current owner, call transferOwnership() to transfer ownership to a new address. The vulnerability is that the previous owner remains in the authorizations mapping. After transfer, the previous owner can still call authorized functions like setFeeReceivers(), setBuyFees(), setSellFees(), etc. to manipulate contract parameters or drain funds. The exploit demonstrates unauthorized privilege retention.
